QuestInfo.name: The Burning Lands
QuestInfo.0: Stands with Bulls is looking for an explorer who can eliminate Fire Boars. You're all about eliminating, so visit him in #m102030200#.
QuestInfo.1: Many adventurers get injured in the Burning Land. For the safety of everyone in Perion, eliminate Fire Boars in #r#m102030300##k and #r#m102030400##k.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated 200 Fire Boars. This area should be a bit safer now, right?

0.0: I see more and more innocents hurt in the Burnt Land of Perion every day. The raging Fire Boars are to blame. It is up to strong Warriors like us to keep the people safe. Are you ready to take on that responsibility?

yes.0: Great. Now go eliminate 200 Fire Boars.

no.0: It seems you have power, but don't know how to use it. Do you not understand your responsibility to protect others?

1.0: Do the Fire Boars number 200 less?

yes.0: Well done. Though you have completed my task, continue to eliminate Fire Boars. Keeping their numbers down will contribute to the safety of Perion.

mob.0: This is not the kind of task you take your time with. Strike swiftly, and powerfully!
